current_change.metric_authority_exact_key_repair: Architect numeric-authority repair now converts validator-local field defects and the existing authority catalog into an exact-key semantic decision object. The LLM must choose one listed source binding, architect_preregistered_design, diagnostic_only, or row removal for every runtime-owned decision key; runtime applies only that choice, preserves every numeric gate, rebuilds structural mirrors, and reruns the unchanged full validator. Successful packets retain compact model-selected application provenance with runtime_selected_semantics=false. Only this lane uses strict_residual_error_set_reduction_v1 after every typed patch; other reviewers retain their bounded progressive-repair policy. V208 replayed V199's final sequential packet with exact claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: one structured-output call selected a theory-derived source binding, reduced the exact validator residual from 1 to 0, and left every numeric field unchanged. This is component evidence, not integrated research or proof closure.
current_change.formalization_gap_route_transport: The over-budget monolithic FormalizationGapPlanner response now falls back to four typed stages with compact, stage-owned provider contracts. Route selection crosses as an exact-key boolean map plus semantic decisions; runtime derives only frozen IDs, policy base costs, arithmetic, action placement, and the mechanical AND/OR projection. Formal DAG mirrors are derived only from model-authored edges and coverage. Every frozen residual index is assigned to one of at most five model-authored semantic batches, while runtime copies exact residual text and covered-index mirrors. Prior accepted fragments are projected compactly for later prompts but remain authoritative for validation and lineage. Later stages receive only their required context, and each formal node exposes the existing allowed attempt-kind/feedback interface contract so the model does not rediscover it through failed calls. Fresh V207 completed all four stages and full assembly with four first-attempt exact-Haiku structured calls and zero repair. No task formula, theorem-family rule, Lean grammar, tactic template, mathematical action, or validator relaxation was added.
current_change.preflight_finding_lineage_transport: When a pre-execution review has active prior findings, provider transport now uses one exact-key object whose required keys are the runtime-owned finding IDs. The LLM judges each keyed finding but no longer recopies IDs into an array, so duplicate or omitted identities are structurally impossible. Current findings still carry prior_finding_id, runtime still derives the canonical ledger, and validators still require exactly one continuation for every UNRESOLVED prior finding and none for a resolved one. V199 crossed the survival second preflight that V198 blocked on duplicate/missing IDs. No statistical formula, task-family rule, or validator relaxation was added.
current_change.audit_rerun_foundation_binding: Capability-audit rerun and resume commands now copy the active manifest's formalizer_candidate_lean_project and exact-semantic source roots. They no longer advertise a legacy Lean checkout after a run that actually used canonical EmpericalProcessLEAN plus pinned Statlib.
current_change.canonical_full_live_foundation: Capability/full-live and ordinary live Formalizer defaults now select the current EmpericalProcessLEAN Lake project before vendored snapshots. Exact-semantic lookup uses the current StatInference source plus the pinned Statlib source; explicit CLI roots remain authoritative and historical snapshots remain fallback/inventory only. Retrieval, compilation, and kernel evidence therefore share one live foundation.
current_change.theory_execution_preflight: Before metric authoring or coding, the independent reviewer now recomputes each guarantee-carrying procedure identity from the primitive DGP, audits data-dependent operators and theorem hypotheses under the conclusion measure, checks finite typed returns, and verifies ideal-to-executable guarantee transport. Runtime-derived booleans gate acceptance; reviewer wording is not parsed as a mathematical rule. A rejection routes through the existing typed TheoryDeveloper task with immutable finding lineage; no second scheduler or task-specific formula was added.
current_change.theory_transport: The same TheoryDeveloper and task now use two bounded provider calls: first a core mathematical workspace, then an executable estimator interface constrained to frozen estimator and semantic-reference IDs. The merged packet is rehashed and validated as one theory artifact. This is transport decomposition, not another agent or scheduler.
current_change.theory_interface_transport: Estimator interfaces now cross the provider boundary as an exact-key object whose required properties are the frozen estimator IDs. Runtime converts that transport into canonical rows in frozen-ID order. This prevents schema descriptions from weakening exact cardinality and prevents duplicated or missing rows without encoding estimator semantics.
current_change.estimator_interface_authoring_contract: TheoryDeveloper now authors only primitive per-output scale semantics. A non-indexed output is exactly {scale:not_indexed}; indexed outputs carry their contribution rate, while runtime derives aggregate exponent summaries and strips legacy synthetic zero fields. Frozen output cardinality and identities remain exact. This removes redundant arithmetic copying from the LLM without hardcoding an estimator formula.
current_change.repair_path_transport: Generic JSON repair now exposes both the raw provider payload and the normalized packet. Preflight typed-patch paths are derived from the raw exact-key transport, while semantic validation remains on the canonical artifact. No numeric-to-key path guessing or validator relaxation was added.
current_change.theory_revision_transport: Independent pre- or post-execution upstream-theory findings now return to the same TheoryDeveloper through one parent-bound revision contract. The runtime verifies exact parent packet id/hash, feedback fingerprint, reviewer packet/execution identity, and Architect dispatch before applying at most 20 typed updates only to existing parent paths. Every unmentioned field remains immutable, the complete core is revalidated, and no task formula, theorem alias, deterministic answer, or second scheduler is encoded.
current_change.postexecution_theory_revision_transport: Generated-code semantic review now binds execution diagnostics to the exact current TheoryDeveloper packet in blackboard and the current metric-theory handoff. Stale preflight material may remain as history but cannot be selected. The shared revision budget accumulates pre-execution and post-execution revisions across the question, and invalid or stale lineage blocks before any model call. A v174 exact-artifact replay plus live exact-Haiku component probe used the current b7c819 parent, completed targeted core revision and estimator-interface authoring in 64.361 seconds, and preserved parent ID/hash and binding ID. This is component evidence, not integrated research or proof completion.
current_change.theory_stage_recovery: A locally valid core is checkpointed when only estimator-interface authoring fails. Runtime retries resume that exact hash-bound phase instead of regenerating the completed core. Interface prompts and repairs receive the core's actual semantic-reference IDs; one bounded strict-progress patch extension remains available after truncation or a smaller residual. A live exact-Haiku replay resumed the v171 checkpoint and passed in one interface call with zero validation errors.
current_change.theory_gate_scope: Self-critique remains useful serious-workspace content but is not a standalone hard execution gate. V173 showed that requiring a non-empty reflection list caused four repairs and 180 seconds of waste while an independent semantic reviewer already owned substantive criticism; that cosmetic validator and its test were removed.
current_change.metric_review_transport: The independent pre-execution reviewer receives a compact projection of immutable authority, a single typed array for variable-count theory-scope checks, and runtime-owned prior-finding identity/evidence binding. Local validators still check the full source material and exact coverage.
current_change.semantic_audit: Generic prompts require primitive DGP/estimand reconstruction, full-support expectation or probability expansion, normalization, boundary checks, and alignment with Architect formal/simulation targets. No statistical task formula was added.
current_change.formalizer_strategy: Exact target and assumptions, source-local module and namespace as distinct identities, the current dependency-ordered frontier, real Lean/LSP diagnostics, preservation of verified ancestors, and independent statement/counterexample review after persistent failure. Each packet carries one semantic obligation per node and only its actual support edges; a direct proof uses an empty dependency plan. Every retry binds the failed candidate and changed proof state. Library placement follows reusable mathematical dependencies rather than textbook order, declarations use source-local semantic names, and book theorem numbers remain citation metadata. No Lean syntax or tactic repair rule was added.

StatInference remains the downstream large-scale statistics library, while stable general abstractions move upstream only after review. EmpericalProcessLEAN main now points to 2053b8f7 after seven branch-only proof commits were recovered and their barrier, stationary-chain, and Bernstein modules were connected to StatInference.lean. A clean 9,824-job root build, 11 source-integration tests, declaration-policy checks over all 8 added declarations, and namespace-aware axiom scans over all 7 recovered public theorems passed with zero unexpected axioms. All 489 WDSM modules and every other unique source module remain reachable; 151 declaration-duplicating Matching compatibility mirrors remain excluded.
current_change.formal_rag_canonical_scope: Schema-v5 production graphs follow the canonical Lean entry-module import closure and exclude private, local, anonymous, and compatibility-mirror declarations. The bound StatInference graph now has 1,192 canonical Lean files, 51,993 declarations, 3,710 import edges, and 210,115 declaration edges with zero duplicate names or sorry/admit; pinned Statlib has 32 declarations and AI4SLT has 2,000. Source-authored structural quality metadata ranks semantic APIs; declarations marked oversized_name are hidden from ordinary semantic retrieval but remain available by exact full or short name. BOUND_MATCH means corpus freshness only; target-project import visibility and exact local re-elaboration remain mandatory.
current_change.formal_source_topology: Dependency graphs are identified from snapshot metadata rather than database filenames and resolved against the active project. StatInference is the active research library and now explicitly declares pinned Statlib as a source dependency; source-scoped retrieval expands only through declared transitive dependencies. A live empirical_process_lean-only QMD query returned both StatInference and Statlib declarations and excluded AI4SLT. Statlib uses the active Lean v4.30.0 and Mathlib revision; AI4SLT remains a Lean v4.32.0 port corpus. Topology affects source eligibility, not relevance scores or proof status, and every topology row is explicitly non-proof evidence.
current_change.post_runtime_formal_execution: After AgentRuntime terminates, formal queues are projection-only. Retrieval, LLM authoring, semantic bridges, proof search, local Lean, kernel checks, and promotion can execute only as Architect-visible typed AgentTasks. Runtime config suppression is unconditional across modes; projected debt cannot become proof evidence.
current_change.typed_only_authoring_retry: An auto-requested exact-semantic authoring retry now means that the next Architect-visible typed task is required; it no longer enables a post-runtime authoring worker, materializer, Lean executor, or verifier side effect. Skipped manifests record post_runtime_typed_agent_task_required.
current_change.legacy_lean_reconciliation: Both vendored StatInference snapshots were compared with current EmpericalProcessLEAN. All 830 historical Lean paths have current owners. All 1,412 changed vendored-EmpericalProcess declarations retain current short-name owners; 137/142 changed legacy-AI declarations do likewise. current_change.theory_formal_rag_projection: TheoryDeveloper now compares the top three ranked qualified declaration signatures so a direct semantic match at rank three is not discarded. Only the primary candidate may carry one bounded source-authored declaration doc or citation; secondary prose, broad module summaries, and every proof body are omitted. Architect proof skeletons are routing proposals rather than mathematical authority, so the LLM may choose a more direct retrieved declaration while preserving the exact target and evidence gates.
current_change.research_eval_metric_semantics: Research completion now follows the frozen metric contract's required flag: at least one authority-bound metric must execute and pass, and all required metrics must pass. Failed optional diagnostics remain explicit failed observations but do not masquerade as required-gate failure. No threshold, task metric, or observed value was changed.
current_change.theory_cli_model_binding: An explicit Anthropic CLI model now binds both ordinary and serious TheoryDeveloper phases to that exact model and inferred tier. This closes the serious-mode override that made one discarded, mislabeled probe invoke Sonnet despite a Haiku CLI request. The invalid probe was removed, no evidence was retained from it, and no Opus request occurred.
current_change.formalizer_declaration_identity: Formalizer source-to-bridge candidates now bind an explicit declaration identity to the runtime request, then use the same shared local Lean source-compilation plus #check probe as ordinary Formalizer candidates. Packet validation no longer parses generated source for a hardcoded theorem keyword, so source-local lemma/namespace conventions reach Lean unchanged. A source that compiles but does not export the requested identity remains non-evidence and is classified as a wrong declaration.
current_change.formal_rag_queries: Initial retrieval keeps an exact qualified-name query first, then consumes an explicit upstream source citation/query when present, then theorem semantics and required definitions/lemmas within the bounded query budget. Explicit source ids or source-target provenance are carried into the Formalizer instead of guessed by the runtime. Once Lean feedback exists, the three bounded lanes become one live goal/diagnostic, one unknown API when present, and one semantic target. Repeated declarations across query groups are removed. Imports remain visibility metadata rather than lexical hits, and relative dotted Lean declarations preserve their enclosing namespace.
current_change.formal_rag_fusion: Providers are fused by declaration identity and normalized signature using strongest relevance plus a bounded corroboration bonus. Reindexing one source cannot multiply its score. A source-bound request is now a real main-source allowlist: providers without scoped search have out-of-scope hits removed and counted, while explicitly declared anchor-scoped companion corpora remain provider-owned support context.
current_change.formal_rag_cache: The persistent SQLite index is bound to schema version, declaration fingerprint, source-root snapshots, and README/toolchain metadata; changed source material rebuilds the index instead of serving stale declarations.
current_change.formal_rag_source_architecture: The generic Lean index keeps source-authored declaration docs, active section summaries, README layer/module tables, and nearby semantic names as retrieval metadata, with no SLT package-name special case. Generic ranking rewards source-cited or source-outlined public declarations and semantic declaration-name coverage without encoding any theorem name. For initial authoring, the dependency adapter derives a bounded three-level local-module route from the version-bound import graph and maps it conservatively to source-authored layers; ambiguous suffix matches remain unlabeled. The compact prompt groups repeated depths by layer and carries one representative exact module for at most four layers. An exact declaration-identity query transports only its exact rank-one target, while semantic source discovery may still retain two candidates. Namespace ancestry, duplicate direct-import fields, broad prose, nearby names, and proof bodies are omitted; repair packets also omit the architecture route.
current_change.formalizer_phase_aware_prompt_transport: Initial task-bound formal-source grounding is not misclassified as a ProofEngineer repair loop. Once initial hits are materialized, query seeds, owner labels, duplicated policy prose, inactive source-to-bridge schemas, and inactive PF/BV schemas are omitted from the provider prompt; real diagnostic/proof-state contexts retain their active contracts. Optional retrieval, gap, critic, and action arrays may be empty, and the runtime no longer fabricates generic rows. A minimal Formalizer prompt is 7,159 characters; the three current source-grounded book probes are 10,655 to 11,320 characters. Semantic authority fields, task-bound fingerprints, active validators, and proof boundaries remain intact.
current_change.formal_rag_trace_alignment: AI4SLT declaration hits supply bounded exact theorem-name and exact module anchors to train-only proof-state retrieval. Declaration and trace RAG now share nested runtime goal/diagnostic extraction. Live proof-state overlap remains mandatory and receives first token priority; unrelated source ids are ignored. Changed state/query-role/source-scope fingerprints refresh both layers, and stale declaration hits are removed if no retriever is available. This creates neither a tactic template nor proof evidence.
current_change.formal_rag_declaration_identity: The shared source parser and runtime graph adapter preserve complete Unicode Lean declaration identities, including inline-attributed declarations, and reject unversioned, pre-v4, identity-policy-incompatible, or reference-policy-incompatible graphs before retrieval. Schema 5 strips comments and strings, excludes private/local/anonymous generated declarations, follows an optional canonical entry-module import closure, and does not guess receiver-style h.foo projections. This is a generic source-index contract, not a Lean grammar repair rule or theorem-family policy.
current_change.formal_source_physical_identity: Overlapping configured source roots index each resolved physical Lean file once, with configured root order defining ownership. Superseded vendored snapshots are inventory/training inputs rather than live roots. Dependency graphs remain separate version-bound corpora: StatInference 51,993, Statlib 32, and AI4SLT 2,000 retrievable public declarations.
current_change.generated_code_profile_transport: AlgorithmEngineer and SimulationEngineer share one provider schema with three structural branches: Python stdlib omits dependencies, while Python or R scientific_wasm declares only supported imported packages. Runtime still performs the authoritative safety and execution checks. Simulation output budget is 8,000 tokens to avoid predictable code-plus-metrics truncation.
current_change.generated_code_review_provenance: Independent generated-code review treats procedure_id as an immutable authority identity and keeps large execution projections under canonical exact_result. Historical /exact_result/projection locators remain readable only through an explicit canonical_locator compatibility projection. Review acceptance therefore binds the exact procedure, source, arguments, results, theory packet, and frozen metric protocol rather than a nearby artifact.
